blocks.text: Haunted Hotel Halloween returns October 16 – November 15, 2026, with a full month of spooky attractions, scary sweets, and shared thrills for families, couples, and friends There’s a science to screaming together. Studies in psychology and behavioral research have long suggested that sharing a controlled scare — the kind where you know, deep down, that you’re actually safe — triggers a rush of adrenaline and endorphins that can heighten bonding, deepen trust, and leave people feeling closer to one another than before. Couples, in particular, have been known to find the experience, shall we say, invigorating. That’s the delightfully wicked […]...
